decisions.reason: This distributed airfield lighting control unit builds directly on the firm's deep airfield-lighting, control and integration knowledge, so its absorptive capacity to refine and commercialize it is high.

An air situation display fits closely with the firm's surveillance and airport-operations portfolio, making it a product the firm can learn from and improve without stretching far beyond existing capabilities.

The airport systems training program is strongly related to the firm's installed base and service model, so it is likely to be retained as a complementary offer even if it is not a major growth engine on its own.

The airfield ground lighting training course is highly related to existing know-how but is narrow and easier to fold into broader service packages, so management is more likely to remove it as a standalone market offer.
The airport collaboration software tool matches the firm's strategic move toward integrated, real-time and collaborative airport operations, giving it strong strategic and knowledge-based support.

As a flagship multilateration surveillance system that sits at the core of the firm's future direction and technical base, it is the kind of product management is most likely to continue backing and developing.
